hero.subheadline: Accurate building data for property management, renovation and upgrades across multiple commercial sites.

coreRisk.headline: When you manage multiple properties, small errors don't stay small.
coreRisk.body: Across a portfolio, documentation is rarely consistent. Some sites have updated drawings. Some don't. Measurements differ. Standards vary between assets. Consultants reinterpret information each time a project starts. Teams return to site to double-check. Similar buildings require repeated measurement work. One mistake is manageable. Repeated across 15 or 40 properties, it becomes recurring cost, delay and frustration.

friction.headline: Three problems that compound across your portfolio

point0.title: Reduce dependency on physical site visits
point0.description: When properties are spread across cities or regions, verification usually means travel. High-accuracy 3D capture allows verified building conditions to be reviewed remotely — without returning to site.

point1.title: Don't rediscover the building every time
point1.description: Too often, each project begins with the same question: 'Do we have reliable drawings for this site?' We structure digital models so they remain usable across the portfolio for every future project.

point2.title: Avoid coordination friction before projects begin
point2.description: Many as-built models are delivered as a single combined file. When required, RESCAN structures models by discipline — architecture, plumbing, ventilation and electrical — in Revit or Archicad.

strategicValue.headline: One verified foundation. Every project starts from known conditions.

valueA.title: Remote access to verified building data
valueA.description: Dimensions, layouts and systems can be checked without returning to site. Fewer interruptions. Faster decisions. Less repeated effort across locations.

valueB.title: Models structured for the portfolio lifecycle
valueB.description: Delivered for use across the portfolio and integration with existing property management systems. Used for tenant adaptations, planned maintenance, system upgrades and lease-driven changes.

differentiator.headline: Proven in commercial environments.
differentiator.subheadline: 250+ commercial and industrial projects delivered. 1.8M+ m² digitally captured. Including retail units, office buildings and mixed-use commercial assets across Sweden and beyond.

namedCase.label: Portfolio case
namedCase.headline: Carlqvist Property — 56 commercial properties digitised across Sweden
namedCase.body: Carlqvist Property engaged RESCAN to digitise its mixed commercial portfolio of 56 properties across Sweden. The objective was not a single refurbishment project — it was to create one consistent, reliable digital foundation across all assets. Each property was captured and structured into accurate digital documentation, forming a centralised archive of verified building data.
namedCase.quote: We now have a clear and reliable overview across all properties. It saves time and reduces uncertainty whenever a new project starts.
